concept.title: People with mental health conditions
concept.shortdesc: People experiencing mental health difficulties, including women in crisis and those with OCD and related conditions, and their families.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Women experiencing mental health difficulties, crisis or self-harm.
: People affected by obsessive-compulsive disorder and related conditions such as body dysmorphia, phobias or hair-pulling, and their families.
